Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier as compound_chembl_id and canonical SMILES from molecule_dictionary joined with activities on molregno, then with assays on assay_id, then with target_dictionary on tid, and finally with compound_structures on molregno. Filter to target CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
